description: This file defines the IStateController interface and its nested INotification interface within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It provides methods for managing and observing state changes of a remote object, including registration, unregistration, querying current state, and requesting state changes.

classes.name: IStateController
classes.description: Interface for controlling and monitoring the state of a remote object, including commands for suspend and resume, and notifications for state changes.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Nested interface within IStateController for receiving notifications about state changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for state change events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the service.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests a change to the specified state (suspend or resume).
